svg.title: Cooling plant CP-A03 dimensioned architecture plan
svg.desc: Original section-local architectural floorplan, service reserves, machinery and proposed reactor connector. Dimensions in metres. Not runtime validation.

g.text: CP-A03 · DIMENSIONED LOCAL PLAN + PORTAL SECTION · 11 SEP 2026
METRES | entry (0,0,0) | +Y into room | +Z up | proposed module, connection not applied
CP-P01 / 5.00 W × 5.00 H / OVERHEAD DOOR FIXED OPEN
Ceiling plane Z5.80m; girders descend to Z5.385m. Walls
0.30m. Floor is flush; no raised platform. Section stays
at local Y ≥ 0. See saved-scene verification separately.
The 2.20m centre lane is permanent. The east 1.20m strip
is equipment reach space, and the rear withdrawal box is a
reserved work volume. Neither is a public cart route.
Reserve terminal and capped mine-water connection support
later emergency recovery. No external utility endpoints
Mate at reactor-owned stub OUTER END (11.016295,
−11.016295, 0); rotate −135° about Z. Reactor retains its
3.7m stub and closed doors. Proposed transform remains
Whole-shell plan separation: Control ≥3.515m in Y; east
stair ≥10.115m in Y. This is a local placement proposal,
not whole-map collision certification. New turbine-room
